name: SimOperandSource::Read (cTSObject::vf4_7, SimAntics operand reader)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Secondary slot 7 of cTSObject (this = object + 4): (owner, id, SimDataRef*, float dest, zeroed dest, clear flag, arg7), ax result, errors thrown as short codes (a missing stack frame throws the game's cTSTreeStack unnamed enum 0x3ea, type name checked). Owners -1..51 all ported (see OperandReader.h). Differential: recording-fake world (object body + 33 fakes), 6000 seeds x 63 owner values, half of the worlds friendly (valid stack/person), compared on value, exception, every call with arguments, dest/float/zeroed outputs; owner 22 and 50 run only when a person exists (ORIGINAL-BUG: person data unchecked, null deref). NOT covered: owner 0x17 ids 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 (they call original time/skill code 0x7decd0 0x7e4250 0x7e24f0 0x7e43c0 that needs the game's calendar service; the calls are plain cdecl calls, a trace check must cover them); owner 2 with a null table and non-zero length faults in the original as well (test gives a table). 80 mutants (all owners, prologue/epilogue, stack lookup): 76 killed in the reader test; survivors are equivalent (owner 45 negative-temps check: the unsigned range check throws the same 0x6d; owner 47 uint16 vs int16 index after a >= 0 check) except one gap fixed (stack-object id 0 accepted; now killed) and one killed by the helper test (BindObjectData id 0xc9).

name: OperandRef::Bind (reader helper: bind a SimDataRef to an element pointer)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). __thiscall ret 0xc (ptr, index, length): length = ptr && length>0 ? length : 0; index = index when 0 < index < length else 0; range full. Only caller is the reader. Edge x edge grid plus 100,000 random; mutants killed through the reader test.

name: OperandRef::MakeFromBase (reader helper: bind to a run's start)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Like Bind, but a valid index advances the pointer (ptr + index); returns this. Only caller is the reader.

name: RoundHalfAway (float to int, halves away from zero, through double)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). __cdecl float -> eax. 400,000 floats incl. NaN, infinities, halves, int limits. Only caller is the reader.

name: BindObjectData (reader helper for owners 21 and 51)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). __cdecl (object, id, dest): asks the object's slot 7 for a run (id - 1 for ids 1,15,22,24,30,53,65,71,73,93 through a byte table; ids >= 0xc9 length 2 else 0x6c). All 65,536 low words, with/without data, random high bits. Only caller is the reader.
